qualification_question: Can the already sealed full-DCT K2 reconstruction be fixed, without substitution, as an independently adequate reference for candidate contracts frozen after v197 on the same opened p22 roster?
role: post-result, future-only reference qualification from already sealed v196 evidence; it does not alter or rescue v196, evaluate a new candidate, open new data, train a model, or establish resource speedup

known_before_v197_freeze: v196 full-DCT K2 was independently reproduced and passed 2626 of 2626 strict cells and 26 of 26 complete calibration-sensor groups
v196 Zero-CGLS K4 passed 0 of 2626 strict cells
v196.1 established that the v196 Zero-K4 inadequacy branch was predetermined before the v196 freeze
selection_chronology.future_only_rule: The reference is selected after seeing v196 and may therefore be used only by candidate contracts frozen after this v197 protocol. It cannot be substituted into v196 or cited as prospective v196 evidence.

fixed_reference_identity.name: full_dct_k2_future_reference
fixed_reference_identity.frame_indices: all integers 0 through 100 in immutable order
fixed_reference_identity.calibration_indices: all integers 0 through 12 in immutable order
fixed_reference_identity.initializer: the exact v195 full_dct coordinate reconstructed with the frozen v186 affine center and 1009-row field basis
fixed_reference_identity.refinement: exactly two iterations of the unchanged strict v10.1 identity-preconditioned CGLS recurrence
fixed_reference_identity.inputs: deployment-visible vector observation and reported active-camera geometry only
fixed_reference_identity.dense_online_work: read all 575 non-DC detector-potential coordinates per active camera and form a dense 1009-coordinate field initializer
fixed_reference_identity.permitted_scope: future candidate contracts on exactly this already-opened p22 roster until a separate reference is qualified for another trajectory or data family

immutable_items: reference algorithm, arm index, sensor roster, trajectory, frame order and calibration order
initializer basis, affine center, coordinate normalization, CGLS recurrence and depth
absolute thresholds, quantile method, logical call ledger and geometry-cache disclosure
all bound formal and independent arrays, reports, decisions and ready seals
forbidden: substitute Zero-K4, full-DCT K1, a deeper CGLS endpoint or any future candidate as the reference
change a threshold or reference output after seeing a future candidate
reuse this p22-only qualification as validation, test, external, curved-ray or real-BOST evidence
claim that v197 retrospectively changes the v196 decision

must_recompute_from_bound_formal_arrays: all 2626 full-DCT K2 cell metrics and strict masks
all 26 complete-group p90-higher and worst tails
positive threshold margins for every cell and complete group
the exact [3A, 2A^T] logical call ledger and the fixed dense setup disclosure

must_compute_before_reading_v197_formal_: adequacy from the independently generated v196 metrics and strict masks
all cell and group margins using a separately written aggregation loop
the reference arm and call ledger identity

fixed_decision_order: Any evidence-binding, status, shape, finite, metric-order, strict-mask, group-tail, call-ledger, source-cleanliness or formal-independent comparison failure makes v197 inconclusive.

If the fixed full-DCT K2 reference fails any one of 2626 strict cells or any one of 26 complete groups, conclude FAIL_FULL_DCT_K2_FUTURE_REFERENCE_QUALIFICATION_V197 and do not evaluate a new candidate against it.
Only if the fixed reference passes all cells and groups with positive margins and the independent implementation agrees may v197 conclude PASS_FUTURE_ONLY_FULL_DCT_K2_REFERENCE_QUALIFICATION_V197.

A v197 pass authorizes only one separately frozen, physically distinct candidate contract on the same opened p22 roster. That contract must retain absolute truth gates, the fixed reference, Zero/BP/CGLS/PCGLS/dual-ridge controls, exact-call accounting and an independent second implementation.
No v197 outcome is a compact initializer, learned algorithm, validation, external generalization, exact resource speedup, curved-ray result, real-BOST result, paper success or algorithm breakthrough.
